# hetznerrobot_ip_mac (Resource)

A separate MAC address for a single additional IP — needed to bridge it to a virtual machine. Robot generates the address; destroying the resource removes it again. Limited to 10 changes per hour.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A separate MAC for an additional IP, e.g. to bridge it to a VM.
resource "hetznerrobot_ip_mac" "vm" {
  ip = "123.123.123.125"
}

output "vm_mac" {
  value = hetznerrobot_ip_mac.vm.mac
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) The IP address.

### Read-Only

- `mac` (String) The generated MAC address.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import hetznerrobot_ip_mac.vm 123.123.123.125
```
